title: shape tween colorEffect ignores easeCurve — uses linearT
description: In timeline-query.ts, the shape tween branch calls interpolateColorEffect(fromCE, toCE, linearT) with raw linearT, bypassing the span's ease curve. The motion tween path correctly calls easedT(config.easeForColor). Fix: apply applyEase(linearT, span.ease, span.easeCurve) before passing to interpolateColorEffect in the shape tween branch.
